dry_run_replay_steps.action: Regenerate dry-run outbox structures locally from source approval preview to verify build parity
Inspect outbox dry-run payload text and formatting against UI container styling
Ensure dry-run hashes match across local execution files

evidence_collection_checklist.label: Collect generated dispatch outbox dry-run payload hashes
Capture local browser screenshots of all V5 dispatch & platform panels
Verify zero live/webhook calls are recorded in local transaction logger
Save operator recovery runbook and preflight checklist to automation docs

failure_mode_matrix.impact: Deferred platform entries fail to load preview metadata
failure_mode_matrix.recovery_action: Retain deferred state; do not retry network calls; fallback to manual publishing

failure_mode_matrix.impact: Discord/Telegram webhook dry-run target fails local JSON serialization
failure_mode_matrix.recovery_action: Check structure formats; regenerate JSON payload templates; do not send requests

failure_mode_matrix.impact: Platform payload preview truncated or layout distorted
failure_mode_matrix.recovery_action: Adjust styling containment classes (e.g. break-all); regenerate preview

manual_dispatch_fallback_steps.action: Copy platform-native variant payload from Platform Preview tab
Authenticate manually to the respective platform web interfaces (Substack, Discord, Telegram, X, Threads, Facebook)
Paste payloads into the draft composer, perform a final visual validation, and post/dispatch
Wait for public URL generation on live platforms, and copy URL for the audit import phase

operator_preflight_checklist.label: Verify local kill-switch flag is active
Assert all live credentials and secrets are fully redacted from local database
Validate destination room/channel binding descriptors match manual-only fixtures
Confirm dry-run payload hash matches the signed canonical draft approval record
Ensure manual fallback guidelines are accessible by local operator

platform_specific_recovery_notes.discord_webhook_preview_recovery: Verify mock payload matches Discord webhook body schema; do not invoke live webhooks.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.facebook_manual_recovery: Facebook page post must be created manually via Meta Business Suite interface.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.instagram_deferred_recovery: Instagram is deferred. Maintain deferred status. Do not try to authenticate via mobile/API.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.linkedin_deferred_recovery: LinkedIn is future-gated. Maintain deferred status until explicit live distribution scope is granted.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.substack_manual_recovery: Use Substack dashboard draft editor to paste preview content; schedule manually if needed.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.telegram_operator_preview_recovery: Confirm telegram JSON structure meets bot message requirements; copy manually to client.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.threads_manual_recovery: Threads requires manual copy-paste from browser; automation endpoints remain disabled.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.tiktok_deferred_recovery: TikTok video caption is deferred. Maintain deferred status.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.x_manual_recovery: Paste text into composer; ensure character counts remain within post limits; do not automate tweet dispatch.
platform_specific_recovery_notes.youtube_deferred_recovery: YouTube video description is deferred. Maintain deferred status.

rollback_and_stop_conditions.action: Halt immediately, delete temporary draft preview, and restart intake validation
rollback_and_stop_conditions.event: Payload hash mismatch against signed approval record

rollback_and_stop_conditions.action: Trigger kill-switch, lock credentials, and stop local build server
rollback_and_stop_conditions.event: Unexpected live request or platform API call attempted during local run

rollback_and_stop_conditions.action: Reject draft, flag compliance violation, and notify operator
rollback_and_stop_conditions.event: Wording warning triggered (e.g., trading recommendation language found)
